title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
author: Stieg Larsson
summary: A disgraced journalist is hired to look into the decades-old disappearance of a girl from a wealthy Swedish family, and teams up with a prickly, brilliant hacker named Lisbeth Salander.
readIf: you like a cold, atmospheric Scandinavian mystery with a standout heroine.
skipIf: you can't read graphic scenes of sexual violence.

pairings.reason: The direct sequel, where Lisbeth's own past takes centre stage.
A long, classic-feeling detective story with less brutality and a sharp pair of leads.
Another dark, bleak mystery of small-town secrets, with a damaged protagonist.
